programme: RFXANK and RFXAP are the two non-DNA-binding subunits of the RFX transactivation complex (normally completed by RFX5, not in this list) that sits on the X1-X2/Y-box of HLA class II promoters together with the CIITA coactivator. Their target lists are almost the same HLA-D locus (HLA-DRA, HLA-DPA1, HLA-DPB1, HLA-DMA, HLA-DMB, HLA-DOA, HLA-DOB, HLA-DQB2, HLA-E) plus CIITA itself, which is the signature of the canonical MHC class II transcriptional module rather than a coincidence of two unrelated factors.
role_in_a: In COVID-19, MHC class II output on monocytes/antigen-presenting cells is a clinically tracked axis: its collapse (loss of surface HLA-DR) is a recognised feature of the more severe, immunoparalysed end of the disease.
role_in_b: In endometrial carcinoma, MHC class II expression by tumour and stromal cells governs CD4 T-cell antigen presentation and is the basis for the immunogenic, mismatch-repair-deficient (MSI-high) subset of the disease that is stratified for checkpoint immunotherapy.
shared_axis: Both diseases have a clinically meaningful swing in MHC class II transcriptional output through the same RFX-driven module, moving in opposite directions — suppressed on circulating monocytes in severe COVID-19, elevated in immunogenic endometrial tumours — so the module could be flagging disease-state/immunogenicity in each rather than being unique to either.
reasoning: The RFX/MHC-II module is real and nameable from the factors alone (RFXANK and RFXAP converge almost exactly on the same HLA-D targets), and each disease is separately and robustly tied to MHC-II biology in general biomedical knowledge, so the connection follows by reasoning. But nothing in the retrieved record actually places these two factors in either disease: Open Targets shows only a marginal COVID-19 score for RFXANK and none for RFXAP, no association at all for endometrial carcinoma for either, and the one retrieved paper is a pan-cancer study the reader flagged as not specific to endometrial carcinoma.
support: none found — no PMID in the material substantively places RFXANK or RFXAP in COVID-19 or endometrial carcinoma; the single retrieved hit associated with them is a pan-cancer paper the reader could not confirm as relevant to endometrial carcinoma specifically.
how_to_falsify: In matched severe-vs-mild COVID-19 PBMC/monocyte subsets and MSI-high-vs-MSS endometrial tumour samples, measure RFXANK/RFXAP occupancy at HLA-D promoters (ChIP or ATAC footprinting) alongside HLA-DRA/CIITA transcript or surface HLA-DR protein levels; if RFX occupancy does not track with the expression swing in either dataset, the module is not driving the observed target-set agreement.
caveats: This is a blood-vs-uterus pairing, so any shared mechanism has to run through immune cells present in both compartments (monocytes/APCs infiltrating the tumour), not shared epithelial biology. The concordance rests on only 24 patient-group comparisons from 2 independent cohort pairs, and RFXANK/RFXAP support tops out at 10/24 — the low end of the surviving list, well below TCFL5's 16/24 (which has no comparable biological story). Several tissue-generic exclusions (SPIB, NFATC1, FLI1, CREB5) were immune-associated factors removed before ranking, meaning a broader immune-module signal may have been trimmed away, and the surviving RFXANK/RFXAP pairing should not be read as the whole immune picture.
